title: Fresh-install truncator updated for Simple CMS

entries.summary: truncate_fresh_install.php truncates cms_* tables (pages, posts, media, menus, revisions, redirects, templates, …), ops tables, and leftover legacy PAPeR tables when present.
Default reseed Welcome / General / Hello World / Primary Menu; --no-reseed and --keep-uploads flags; clears public/uploads/media files unless kept.
DEVELOPMENTGUIDE, RUNBOOK, FrameworksGuide, dev-help, backup-restore help updated; obsolete grievance seeder next-steps removed.
